## Experience

#### **Research Data & Operations Assistant (CMDM Lab, UHH)**

*Hamburg, Germany* \| *September 2025 - ongoing*

{{< fa circle-info>}} As a part of the CMDM Lab (PI: Prof. Dr. Sebastian Gluth), I work as a data collection and research assistant. This role involves in instructing and accompanying participants who volunteer to join in decision making studies. In addition, I organize the flow of the testing sessions. After the final part of data collection, I will also take over data analysis. In close collaboration with the lab manager, I also develop guides to make integration of the newly employed people run more smoothly. 

#### **Scientometric Analyst**

*Hamburg, Germany* \| *March 2025 - ongoing*

{{< fa circle-info>}} In a project that involves more than 250 scientists from all over the world, I am responsible for assessing their qualifications based on objective factors such as h-index, publications, impact factors and citations. I work with large spreadsheets and organize, filter, clean, and analyze data and build personalized dashboards of qualifications of the involved people in the project. The data is catches from Google Scholar servers, using a script that I developed via R programming language to optimize the assessment process by automation of repetitive tasks. The result of this project is expected to be published in a world class journal.

*Hamburg, Germany* \| *March 2025 - August 2025*

{{< fa circle-info>}} To gain deeper insight into the research process and acquire hands-on experience, I manage participant data, recruit participants, and expand my knowledge in computational modelling.
